profile_intent: Lossy MP3 source rescue: decoded WAV is only a working print; never call the result lossless restoration.
source_rules: Decode MP3 to WAV only as a working format.
Final WAV is a lossy-source processed print, not a recovered original.
Final MP3 should be encoded once from the final WAV.

forbidden_language.lossless restoration: MP3-derived processing cannot be called lossless restoration.
forbidden_language.true original-resolution master: MP3-derived WAV cannot become an original-resolution master.
